effects.name: NoiseDissolve
effects.algorithm_ideas_adopted: Stable three-octave Perlin fBM, aspect-correct domain, seed offsets, remapped feathered coverage; scale only alpha of straight input.
effects.semantic_contract: progress 0 visible / 1 erased at all softness; seed is floating domain displacement, not integer PRNG; field has no time.
effects.implementation_differences: Freeze domain/hash algorithm, alpha representation and UV origin. Explicit noise implementation must identify differences from MaterialX-derived upstream helper; generic sin-hash is not byte-equivalent.

    scale: number
    softness: number
    seed: number
    invert: boolean

effects.name: ThinFilm
effects.algorithm_ideas_adopted: SDF normal and interior rim, directional/time/thickness phase; cosine rainbow or custom cyclic palette; transparent interior.
effects.semantic_contract: Scale-adjusted SDF; rimWidth has 0.1 scale; degrees lightAngle; rainbow phases 0,0.3333,0.6667; custom mode/colorSpace are structural branches.
effects.implementation_differences: Visual iridescence model, not spectral optical thin-film interference. Analytic 2D SDF first is permitted with explicitly narrower shape coverage; derivative fwidth is local AA, not a substitute for normal gradient.

effects.name: Holographic
effects.algorithm_ideas_adopted: Pillow/volumetric normals plus wrinkle finite differences, directional cosine spectrum, fixed studio light, glitter and grain.
effects.semantic_contract: Normal stencil 0.008; wrinkle stencil 0.02; hueShift degrees /360; exact thirds palette; accumulated animated time; upstream exposes no seed.
effects.implementation_differences: Adding local seed is an extension; fixed time alone reproduces the original fixed-domain noise. Macro surface-locked and screen-stable grain domains must not be conflated. Not a holographic wave simulation.

effects.name: Neon
effects.algorithm_ideas_adopted: Signed-distance tube, semicircular cross-section lighting and hot core plus independently controlled two exponential exterior glows.
effects.semantic_contract: Center plus cardinal SDF neighbors; core/tube/glow controls separate; glow cutoff forces distant alpha=0; flicker/flow use time.
effects.implementation_differences: Implement analytic glow before any extra Bloom pass; report straight/associated color and blend state; reverse-edge smoothstep in source must become ordered-edge explicit inverse in GLSL.

effects.name: Emboss
effects.algorithm_ideas_adopted: Signed height over SDF, central differences for normal, two shadow taps and parallax-like input UV warp.
effects.semantic_contract: Child RTT is premultiplied; unpremultiply before color math then return straight RGBA; signed depth controls raised/sunken; outside shape passes input through.
effects.implementation_differences: No physical displacement geometry claim. Test a known planar/ramp height with reversed light and signed depth, transparent input hidden RGB and no double premultiply.

effects.name: Sparkle
effects.algorithm_ideas_adopted: Two jittered grids of points; alpha-weighted brightest-neighbor luminance gates deterministic twinkling analytic star glints; add to input.
effects.semantic_contract: CSS-pixel size/rays/expand; threshold on sqrt(linear luma), band=0.12; Rec709 luma weights; intensity=0 identity; expand crossing zero changes tap topology; seed domain differs per layer.
effects.implementation_differences: Do not threshold already gamma-encoded RGB; alpha-zero bright input must not spawn stars. Match DPR in logical coordinates and constrain neighborhoods/edge mode; no global bloom proxy.

effects.name: LiquidMetal
effects.algorithm_ideas_adopted: Flow-warped Perlin slopes perturb surface normal; reflected procedural three-softbox studio and specular lobe with channel splitting.
effects.semantic_contract: Ripple frequency times2.6; flow time times0.12; desktop chromatic split vs mobile shared evaluation is build-time device branch; upstream exposes no seed.
effects.implementation_differences: Visual material, not a fluid simulation. Local explicit quality tiers replace upstream hidden viewport heuristic only as documented divergence; freeze view/reflection/color domains and measure tier cost.

effects.name: CursorTrail
effects.algorithm_ideas_adopted: CPU anchor/live-head trail, midpoint quadratic Bezier capsule/cone SDF chain, age color and speed radius; 64x1 point data texture, no compute simulation.
effects.semantic_contract: MAX_POINTS64 including duplicate head; three Bezier subdivisions; speed dt cap0.1s / age cap0.25s; aspect-correct distance; width signed to encode connectivity; newest-overlap paint logic.
effects.implementation_differences: Use Cocos input and director lifecycle; never copy RAF/runtime listeners. Define touch IDs, outside/cancel/resize policy; float32 vs upstream half16 and host smoothing differences affect numerical equivalence.

effects.name: Glass
effects.algorithm_ideas_adopted: Scene/child RTT sampled with SDF-slope refraction, RGB offset dispersion, tint/highlight/Fresnel; optional separable Gaussian intermediate.
effects.semantic_contract: requiresRTT and child=true; blur and aberration crossing zero trigger structural recompilation; blur radius=blur*2; RTT samples premultiplied, effect math straight; first-lobe thickness for volumetric mode.
effects.implementation_differences: Implement Cocos RenderTexture ownership and Camera passes, not upstream compute runtime. Declare local blur kernel/edge/sample mapping and physical-lens limitations; count actual offscreen/blur/final passes.
